narr: Severe thunderstorms and heavy rainfall affected areas from Shackelford County, south into Brown, McCulloch, Menard, and San Saba counties. Also, localized flash flooding was reported.
ev: Law enforcement reported water flowing over FM 1311 just inside the McCulloch County line near Calf Creek, causing the road to be impassable.
An emergency manager reported 6 to 8 feet of water flowing over FM 2092, at the Five Mile Crossing, 5 miles east of Menard. The road was closed due to flooding.
